projects.title: SafeLattice: LLM Agent Safety Evaluation
projects.subtitle: Georgia Tech CS 8903 | Advisor: Prof. Vijay Madisetti | Code & analysis
bullets: Implemented a Python extension to upstream Claw-Eval with severity-aware, Bell-LaPadula-inspired scoring and credential-leakage checks; audited all 300 task graders and added regression tests.
Analyzed 1,222 agent traces across six LLMs with mechanical label checks and bootstrap intervals; measured violation-detection F1 0.81 vs. 0.11 for the binary baseline in this study.

projects.title: Never Trust the Context: Decision Integrity for Agents
projects.subtitle: Policy and evaluation prototype | Repository
bullets: Built context-admission and attribution controls separating confidentiality from evidence integrity; extended evaluation to wrong decisions that do not visibly repeat untrusted content.
Implemented 10 clean/perturbed scenario pairs, a structured scorer for decision corruption, grounding and required-claim coverage, and regression tests. Live-model evaluation remains pending.

projects.title: Grasp Recovery under Delayed Feedback
projects.subtitle: MuJoCo simulation pilot | Repository & data
bullets: Built a grasp-transport-place task with bit-exact replay; collected 400 pilot episodes and 88,728 matched recovery branches under hidden mass/friction and varied observation age and response delay.

Evaluated selectors on 94 held-out episodes with episode-clustered bootstrap intervals; latency-aware selection showed no completion advantage over its latency-agnostic baseline. Preliminary, simulation-only.
